_: createObject alias fill demo. Reuses the proven magic-trigger entry (cast a self-spell -> MFSE_SpellTrigger -> MFStoryEventDispatch.Fire(kw, caster, target) -> SM ScriptEvent root starts MFSE_SpawnTarget). The Caster alias pulls event ref1 (the player). The Spawned alias uses 'createObject:<ref>@Caster' so the engine SPAWNS a new reference to a vanilla wolf base AT the Caster when the quest starts -> a wolf appears next to the player the instant the spell is cast. In-game test: player.addspell the Forge Spawn spell, cast it, watch a wolf materialize; `sqv MFSE_SpawnTarget` -> Running with Caster + Spawned aliases filled.

magicEffects.name: Forge Spawn
magicEffects._: Token self-heal so OnEffectStart runs on the caster; the payload is the attached MFSE_SpellTrigger script.

spells.name: Forge Spawn
spells._: Self-cast — no aiming needed. Wraps MFSE_SpawnEffect.

quests.name: Forge Spawn Target
quests._: Started by the SM ScriptEvent root when MFSE_SpawnKW fires. Caster = event ref1 (the player). Spawned uses createObject to materialize a vanilla wolf (Skyrim.esm:0x0010FE05 = EncWolfRed) AT the Caster alias. The createObject target MUST be a ref-type alias (Caster is fromEvent:ref1) — not a Location.
